lead.headline: OECD Warns Global GDP Faces 'Dark Scenario' as Iran-Gulf Crisis Persists
lead.they_say: Financial consensus holds that Iran-US strikes are an oil market story — contained to crude futures and Middle East risk premia with limited macro spillover.
lead.reality: OECD publishes formal GDP contraction model if Gulf energy corridor disruption lasts through Q3 2026. The ECB signals rate rises regardless of an Iran peace deal. Trump proposes 10%+ broad tariffs on forced labour. Three separate stagflationary forces converging on growth forecasts.
lead.thesis: Markets are pricing a sectoral energy shock. The data reveals a compounding macro regime shift: energy-driven inflation + tariff headwinds + central bank policy constraint = recession risk repricing across bonds, FX, and equities.
lead.actors: OECD, ECB, Federal Reserve, Trump Administration
lead.invalidation_trigger: A confirmed Iran ceasefire that de-escalates Gulf energy corridor threat, or a dovish ECB pivot away from rate normalization.
paradigm_implications: Energy-driven inflation reprices global bond yields upward
Tariff headwinds compress EM equity valuations
Central bank policy constraint limits counter-cyclical stimulus
lead.capital_flow_implication: Capital rotates out of European and EM equities into commodities, gold, and short-duration Treasuries as stagflation repricing crosses asset classes.
lead.portfolio_implication: Portfolio implication: reduce equity exposure across European and EM indices until Q3 GDP revisions clarify recession probability; add gold ETF on pullbacks to 50-day MA as stagflation hedge; overweight energy (XLE) on supply disruption premium.

stories.headline: ECB Rate Rise Still on Table Despite Iran Peace Deal, Central Banker Says
stories.they_say: An Iran ceasefire would remove geopolitical uncertainty and allow the ECB to pause rate normalization.
stories.reality: ECB Governing Council member confirms services inflation at 4.1% keeps tightening bias regardless of Iran outcome. Rate rise probability unchanged at 72% for June meeting.
paradigm_implications: ECB tightening independent of geopolitics constrains European fiscal space
72% rate-hike probability pricing limits bond upside
stories.portfolio_implication: Portfolio implication: establish EUR/USD straddle into June ECB meeting — 72% rate-hike probability priced but Iran ceasefire scenario could trigger a 50-100 pip unwind; hold short-dated European government bonds (2Y Schatz) as rates remain repriced higher regardless of geopolitics.

stories.headline: Trump Proposes 10% Tariffs on Forced Labour, 25% on Brazil
stories.they_say: Tariffs target specific forced labour practices in China and Brazil, limited trade impact expected.
stories.reality: Proposed levies of at least 10% on all imports linked to forced labour — a broad trade-war layer that compounds energy-driven inflation. Brazil tariff hits 25% despite US running a trade surplus with Brazil.
paradigm_implications: Broad tariff layer compounds energy-driven inflation pressures
Brazil-specific tariff signals broader protectionist pivot beyond China
stories.portfolio_implication: Portfolio implication: reduce EM equity and FX exposure (particularly Brazil via EWZ) by 15-20% ahead of tariff implementation; add TIPS or short-dated US Treasuries for inflation pass-through hedge; long USD vs. EM currencies on tariff-induced trade compression.

stories.headline: Iranian Drones Hit Kuwait International Airport
stories.they_say: US-Iran strikes are contained to military targets — civilian infrastructure not at risk.
stories.reality: Kuwait International Airport struck by Iranian drones in escalation on June 3. Civilian infrastructure targeting threshold crossed in the Gulf. Kuwait authorities confirm airport operations suspended.
paradigm_implications: Civilian infrastructure targeting signals escalation, not containment
Gulf energy corridor disruption risk repriced into crude
stories.portfolio_implication: Portfolio implication: buy crude (BZ=F) on headline, target +3-5% within 24h — fade-the-move strategy with exit if prices gap above $78 (overreaction threshold); add energy sector (XLE) 2% position with 5% invalidation stop on diplomatic de-escalation.

stories.headline: Yen Nears 160 Per Dollar as Intervention Risk Mounts
stories.they_say: USD/JPY above 155 is a one-way bet on further yen weakness driven by rate differentials.
stories.reality: Yen crosses 159.50 into BOJ intervention zone. If macro stress from Gulf crisis triggers safe-haven flows, the carry trade unwind accelerates — the opposite of the consensus yen-weakening bet.
paradigm_implications: Yen at intervention zone creates asymmetric downside for USD/JPY longs
Carry trade unwind risk accelerates if Gulf crisis triggers safe-haven flows
stories.portfolio_implication: Portfolio implication: short USD/JPY into 159.50+ with tight 40-pip stop — BOJ intervention risk at 160 creates asymmetric downside; reduce carry trade positions (long AUD/JPY, NZD/JPY) as safe-haven flows accelerate on Gulf crisis; gold (XAU/USD) as alternative safe haven with central bank buying tailwind.

stories.headline: Seven Killed as Drone Hits Bus in Russian-Controlled Ukraine
stories.they_say: Drone strikes in Ukraine are precision military operations with minimal civilian impact.
stories.reality: Seven civilians killed when drone hits a bus in Russian-controlled part of Ukraine. Zelenskyy requests US missiles in response to intensified Russian strikes across the country.
paradigm_implications: Civilian casualties escalate Ukraine conflict intensity
Zelenskyy's missile request tests NATO commitment limits
stories.portfolio_implication: Portfolio implication: add geopolitical risk premium to European natural gas (TTF) via futures or BULL ETF with 2-week horizon; reduce defensive European equity (STOXX 600 hedge with V2EX puts); gold remains constructive as multi-theater conflict premium increases safe-haven bid.

stories.headline: AI Giant Anthropic Plans US Share Sale at Near-$1tn Valuation
stories.they_say: AI capex growth continues without limit — demand for compute and AI services is structurally unbounded.
stories.reality: Anthropic's valuation approaching $1tn while Instagram AI chatbot was hacked to expose user accounts. Concentration risk in AI equity exposure rises even as security vulnerabilities emerge.
paradigm_implications: $1tn valuation signals peak narrative pricing for pure-play AI
Security vulnerabilities emerge as AI concentration risk grows
stories.portfolio_implication: Portfolio implication: take partial profits on pure-play AI equity exposure (NVDA, ANET) — $1tn valuation signals peak narrative pricing; add cybersecurity ETF (CIBR, HACK) 2% position as AI concentration risk and security vulnerability revelations drive rotation from AI builders to AI protectors.
